[red]Death Rewind's[/red] gift, [red]Death Rewind's[/red] curse.
When you play a card with [red]Cycle[/red], automatically play copies from your draw pile that also have [red]Cycle[/red] (max 2).
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_HIRO.title: Hiro's Ending
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_HIRO.description:
[b]Returns to hand at the start of each turn.[/b]
When played, [red]die[/red]. Reduce ally's Witchification by 50. Exhaust ally's Status and Curse cards. Give ally 3 Energy, draw 3.
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_TRANSMIGRATION3.des: When playing a card with [red]Cycle Cycle Cycle[/red], play cards with [red]Cycle Cycle Cycle[/red] from anywhere.
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_AGREE.title: Agreement
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_AGREE.description:
Triggers effect when played count is a multiple of 1-5.
×1: All allies gain 3 Block.
×2: Self gain 3 Block.
×3: All allies gain 1 Temporary Dexterity.
×4: All allies gain 2 Temporary Strength.
×5: Next card is free. All allies gain 1 Energy.
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_DOUBT.title: Doubt
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_DOUBT.description:
Triggers effect when played count is a multiple of 1-5.
×1: Self gain 1 Block.
×2: Self draw 1 card.
×3: Self gain 1 Energy.
×4: Retrieve 1 card from discard pile.
×5: Choose 1 hand card to add Replay 1, choose 1 hand card to add an enchantment.
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_REBUTTAL.title: Rebuttal
MANOSABA_LIN_KEYWORD_REBUTTAL.descriptio:
Triggers effect when played count is a multiple of 1-5.
×1: Deal 1 random damage.
×2: Self gain 1 Strength.
×3: All enemies gain 1 Vulnerable.
×4: Deal 1 damage equal to play count to random targets.
×5: Next Attack plays an additional time.
